format: lossless WebP, original alpha retained; decoded pixels verified
sourceReview: Complete source pages and all 16 extracted image objects were visually compared. Full originals preserved. Source hashes, PDF pages and image objects are recorded in world-history-photo-sources.json.
presentation: Photos are opened from existing place descriptions or explanation dialogs. No new top toolbar or persistent gallery covers the map.

questions.behavior: Names, dates, source credits and interpretations are concealed while unsolved, including in the enlarged photo dialog. Wrong answers retain concealment. Explicit reveal or a correct answer enables full photo information.
